info.value: adantaH . ' kaleH kAlayati kzepe, gatisaNKyAnayordvayoH . kalayed, SabdasaNKyAnavizaye kalate Sapi ' (Slo. 155) iti devaH .

entries.artha_hindi: sArAMSa nikAla kara kahanA, tAtparya kahanA, saMkalana karanA, milAnA

examples: 'tarucCidraprotAn (SaSinaH karAn) bisamiti karI saNkalayati' (suBA॰). saNkalayati=gfhRAti. jAnAti.
'pattIn sarvAn atibalAn yotsyamAnAnavasTitAn. ekaH saNkAlayizyAmi vajrapARirivAsurAn' (BA॰vi॰61.30).. vidrAvayizyAmItyAha.
'saNkalayati kAlayati vA BUtAnIti kAlaH' (suSrute sUtra॰6.2). saNkalayati=saNgfhRAti.
'na tu saNkAlanaM rAjYo vinA putreRa mantriRaH' (rA॰2.66.15). saNkAlanaM pretanirhAram.
'Srayati sOKyamamuM janatA SritA vikalitA kalitApaSatErapi' (pArijAta0 10.25). vikalitA'BiBUtA, asamarTIkftA, vyAkulA, kzuBitA.
'aTa saMkalitavyavakalitayoH karaRasUtraM vfttArDam' iti lIlA0. vyavakalitaM hInIkftam.
'yadi vyakte yuktivyavakalanamArge'si kuSalA' (lIlA0 13). vyavakalanaM SoDanaM nyUnIkaraRam.
'IzadAkalitaM cApi kroDAd drutapadaM sTitam' (BA0 vi0 23.65). AkalitaM vepamAnam.
'tataH paScAdAyAntaM BayahetumAkalayya manTaro jalaM pravizwaH' (hitopa0). Akalayya dfzwvA avabuDya.
'svaM dvIpaM saptavarzARi viBajya saptavarzanAmaBya AtmajeBya Akalayya' (BA0 pu0 5.20.2). Akalayya saMkramayya samarpya.
'prAcetasAdyAH kavayo'navadyA yadekadeSAkalane'pi neSAH' (viSva0 ca0 5.49). Akalane kArtsnyena saNKyAne upavarRane.
'yajYe yajYe yaTAkAlaM dakziRA atyakAlayat' (BA0 droRa0 57.5). atyakAlayat=adadAt. apodaharaditi SabdArTaH.

'gAva utkAlitapuMskA bAhAya ca vikrayAya ca striya evAvaSizyante. kaH punararhatyagrAmyARAM puMsa utkAlayituM ye grahItumaSakyAH kuta eva bAhAya ca vikrayAya ca' (pA0 1.2.73 sUtre BAzyam). utkAlitapuMskAH=nizkAsitapumBAvAH.
'strIlokaH parikalayAYcakAra tulyaM palyaNkErvigalitahAracAruBiH svEH' (SiSu0 8.9). parikalayAYcakAra mene jagrAha.
